$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-org-header-lanes.ts. Every entry names a file that hand-builds a Bearer Authorization header toward a python-backend base URL WITHOUT organization admission, and carries the reason that lane is legitimately org-less or handled elsewhere. Adding an entry is a claim reviewed like code — never a way to silence the guard.

entries.reason: The Bearer token is COOLIFY_API_TOKEN sent to the Coolify control plane (coolify.app.matrxserver.com), not a Supabase JWT to aidream — Coolify has no organization concept and is not behind matrx-connect AuthMiddleware.

The Bearer token is the device owner's relay token sent to the Matrx 2 device relay (relay.matrxserver.com) for a device's live status — the relay authorizes by device ownership, has no organization concept, and is not behind matrx-connect AuthMiddleware.
